MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The TICONN connectors fit my earlier wire connector purchase and offer sealed connections for electrical repairs, making them a useful extension of supplies I have bought before.",
    "WD-40 feels useful alongside my clamps and repair supplies because it supports general hardware maintenance without requiring a particular tool or exact part size."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The cutting wheels and hex nuts require a compatible tool or a specific thread size that my purchases do not establish a need for.",
    "The gloves lack a clear connection to my current repair needs and introduce uncertain sizing; the fabric shaver addresses clothing care rather than the repair supplies I would choose now.",
    "The glue fits my adhesive interests, but ten tubes exceed my current need. The tubing and solder-seal connectors also fit, yet I would choose the varied connector assortment first."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having bought repair supplies seems to have been taken as interest in any workshop consumable, even when its use depends on an unconfirmed project or tool.",
    "My past purchases of packs and assortments seem to have been treated as a general preference for bulk quantities, although quantity only helps when I expect to use the contents."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection is what an item lets me repair: sealed electrical connections build directly on my earlier connector purchase, while cutting metal is a different task.",
    "I choose selectively based on immediate usefulness, compatible specifications, and manageable quantities. Several related wiring products can interest me without my wanting to buy all of them now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into supplies whose task, fit, or quantity does not match what I need now."
}
